queries_run: STMicroelectronics Apple customer concentration risk 2026 credit rating downgrade

findings.claim: 2025 年最大客戶 Apple 占 STM 營收 17.7%（2024 年 14.5%、2023 年 12.3%），逐年上升；公司稱不依賴單一客戶，但失去關鍵客戶或重要 socket 會有不利影響
findings.excerpt: In 2025 our largest customer, Apple, accounted for 17.7% of our total revenues. While we do not believe to be dependent on any one customer or group of customers, the loss of key customers or important sockets at key customers could have an adverse effect on our results of operations and financial condition.

findings.claim: 截至 2025 與 2024 年底，無單一客戶占應收帳款淨額超過 10%，銷貨主要以現金結算，信用風險集中度有限
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 20-F FY2025 財報附註
findings.excerpt: As of December 31, 2025 and 2024, no individual customer represented more than 10% of trade accounts receivable, net. Any remaining concentrations of credit risk with respect to trade receivables are limited due to the large number of customers and their dispersion across many geographic areas.

findings.claim: 券商估計 Apple 2026 年占 STM 營收約 15%（2025 年 17%）
findings.source: Websim - STMicroelectronics Apple riduce gli ordini per iPhone
findings.excerpt: Secondo indiscrezioni di stampa, Apple avrebbe ridotto gli ordini relativi alla gamma iPhone 18 Pro, in un contesto caratterizzato dall'aumento dei costi delle memorie e di altre componenti. Effetto Stimiamo che Apple rappresenterà circa il 15% dei ricavi di STM nel 2026 (dal 17% nel 2025) e che il business legato al cliente cresca di circa il 9%,

customer_concentration_credit.note: 搜尋未見客戶（Apple）信用惡化或破產/降評事件；券商估計（Websim，義大利文，日期不明）Apple 2026 年占比約 15%，未核原文，僅列線索。 線索 1 條，程式核實 1 條
